dossier.headline: Tata Power's Q2 profit jumps; reports differ on the size
dossier.summary: Tata Power reported its highest-ever quarterly profit after hours on November 11. Some reports put it at ₹1,652 crore, up 33%, on revenue up 26% to ₹19,886 crore; others put it at ₹1,366 crore, up 49% on a lower base. Brokerages kept Buy ratings despite cutting targets.
why_it_matters: One of the largest power companies to report this season
Brokerages kept Buy ratings even while trimming target prices
watch: Clarity on the reported profit figure and year-ago base
How far brokerages cut their target prices
questions: Which profit figure matches the company's own filing?
How much did lower Mundra losses contribute?
conflicts: Profit: ₹1,366 crore (up 49% on a ₹919 crore base, Upstox) vs ₹1,652 crore (up 33% on a ₹1,245 crore base, Investywise)
Pre-result estimates ranged from ₹1,010 crore to ₹1,420 crore across brokers
